title: Our Creator Does Not Make Photocopies
body:
Bismillah yaa Sayyidee, yaa RijaalAllah. Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, yaa Sultan al-Awliya, madad, madad,
madad.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah. Sayyidina wa nabiyyina
Muhammadun Rasoolallah! Alfu alfu salaat, alfu alfu salaam `alayka wa `ala aalika wa sahaabatika 'l-kiraam
yaa sayyidi 'l-awaleen wa 'l-aakhireen, yaa Habeebullah. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
As-salaamu ` alaykum, O our Lord’s servants! And we are also saying for our master, who is the controller of
this world and life on it; from the smallest one to the biggest one, every living one must be under his control.
There can’t be any one by its will, no. Nothing can be by itself to do as he likes. Who granted to everything to
be in existence, must be under a control or it can’t be in existence. And that power that is reaching them must
come from one big channel that is going to spread to everything. For this electricity, it is not necessary for
every house to have one electrical center, no; one is enough and sending. This is for understanding, they are
making me to speak. You must understand; a donkey is understanding, but so many human beings are not
understanding. An ant is understanding, but one man from human nature is not understanding. Then it is a
blame, that an ant understands and a man is not understanding. What is that?

Salute to our master who is arranging everything on this world according to al-Lawh al-Mahfoozh, the
Preserved Tablet. Every refined detail is there, and not everyone may look; only the wholly authorized may
look, may understand and may send. We must try to hear and to obey and to follow; that is our mission, what
is coming, yes.
O Salafi `ulamas? Now what you are thinking? You are thinking something, and it is not the same as our
thinking. Everyone has a special being, and a special looking, and a special being through this existence, and
a special understanding, because Allah Almighty is never using a photocopy. Mubdi`, what does it mean, O
Salafi `ulamas? Al-Mubdi`, they are making it as a proof to bring to whole nations, to whole people on this
world. Mubdi` as-samawaati wa 'l-`ard (Originator of the heaven and earth). Mubdi`, that means Allah
Almighty, through His Heavenly Appearances, tajalli, manifestation, everything that He is bringing into
existence, everyone must be in its being, must be only one. (He is) not looking at that one and taking this one,
(or) looking at its creation and creating that one. “Mubdi`” means never appears or was never in existence;
every new creation is only one.
You may look and see, “Oh, they are all the same.” No. “Ants, all of them are the same.” No. Each one, they
have a personality, an identity. If you are going to a government office and they are asking, “Where is your
identity?” are you saying, “I am son of Dr. Fualan.” No. This government is asking to know the identity. But
Allah Almighty is creating everything in its original (form); there can’t be a second one similar, no. Therefore,
that name, yudhishu 'l-`uqool, is astonishing our minds, astonishing our understanding, Mubdi`. Allahu
akbar. We may come to atoms. You are saying hydrogen atoms, and you think that each atom is just the same
as the second one? Each atom has an identity and its muhimmatuh, its mission is different. Even this
hydrogen atom or oxygen atom does not have the same glorification. Everything in existence is also one. For
what?
O Salafi `ulama! Do you know for what this is? We said Allah Almighty is not making photocopies, no. You
can do that photocopy, but one of His Divine Attributes is mukhaalifatun li 'l-hawaadith. That means Allah
Almighty is never going to be (the same as) the creation that He created. Never! There can’t be anything like
Himself, never! Mukhaalifatun li 'l-hawaadith, (different from contingent beings) is that Divine Attribute that
means mukhtas, especially for Him only; no nabi, no wali, no one can be on that plane.

(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Allahu akbar! Allahu akbar! Allahu akbar! Allahu akbar! Mukhaalifatun li 'lhawaadith. Allah, Allah. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Therefore, atoms, that we are knowing are the smallest part of mawjoodaat, existence, they are saying there
are about 90 kinds of atoms, billions, trillions, quadrillions. No, each atom has a special identity. How many
people are here? We are Mankind, we come mixing all together. Is there a different identity or not? Why are
you not accepting this for atoms? These sources of secret knowledge are just opening to Mankind who are
interested in understanding about their Lord, about their Creator. And before we are asking and
understanding about the Lord of Heavens, try to understand the secret through one atom. If we can say the
secret that is just doldumush, full, for an atom, if you are going to open it, you may find hundred, hundred
thousand, hundred millions, hundred trillions of knowledge in there, because each one is going to be a tajalli,
a manifestation of their Creator! Each one is going to be on its level a representative!
A person’s authority or his level of knowledge you can understand through his books. Each atom is a creature
and through that creature you may reach ma`rifatullah, divine knowledge of your Lord. Ohhh. Endless,
countless. Subhaanallah, Subhaanallah, SultaanAllah. Allahu akbaru 'l-akbar! You look at an atom and you
understand, no use for other things. An atom, you are knowing its being in existence, so look to that and you
can understand something from your Creator. One atom is something; the second atom is giving another type
of knowledge carrying for its Creator. Every creation created by the Creator is carrying something about their
Creator. Everything that is coming into existence is bringing something about ma`rifatullah, divine
knowledge of your Lord. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar! SubhaanAllah, Allahu akbar al-akbar!
Sultaan sen ya rabb subhaan sen yaa rabb.
O People! We are saying now, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem, because Shaytan is coming closer
to anyone who is saying such things and (saying this) kicks him out. Say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani
‘r-rajeem, “I am running to my Lord.” But don’t make your Lord to be your bodyguard or guardian to you.
No, people think in such a way.
One atom can take away one-billion shaytans; it is enough, because Shaytan can’t understand the secret
power through an atom; only when touching it he can understand. Now people are fearing from pig flu, but
they are never understanding what a dangerous thing that is until they are touching. Shaytan has just thrown

heavenly atoms. Atoms are going to be different types; atoms that belong to this world, atoms that belong to
heavens. What belongs to our world, because for every world there is some different type of heaven. There are
seven heavens according to our understanding, but for every being like our world, seven heavens belong to
only for this world. Billions or trillions of worlds are coming into existence and everything is coming from
existence, coming from a different situation or a different being; it is not the same. Like this universe may be
our heavens. Another universe and its heavens are different also, and countless, countless worlds and
countless heavens for each one seven, seven, seven. He is Allah Almighty and therefore we are saying
a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. Don’t make Allah to touch that, if He is touching it may take
whole Creation to amar, putting all of them into miracles!
You may ask what is the point of defending people living on this planet, and he is also that one doing
everything on behalf of his Creator. An official is coming and saying, “I am coming for an official declaration
of our majesty, the king,” on behalf of his king or sultan. He is making a declaration, “O creatures, I am on
behalf of my Creator and your Creator. Listen and obey!” We are not knowing anything of real adab, good
manners. Allah Almighty didn’t make him an ordinary being, hasha, hasha, hasha thumma ka’alla. You must
use protocol for everything, to make everything in its real position. Therefore, you must know tashreefaat; it
is important through the heavenly kingdom and countless heavens and countless kingdoms. All of them are
just granted that honor from the Lord of Creation from the beginning up to the end, without a beginning and
without an ending.
Therefore, a holy command for insaan, ahfazh al-adab ma` al-kull, “Keep your good manners with everyone.”
ahfazh al-adab, for everyone, you must keep it. Tashreefat, heavenly protocol and earthly protocol. For every
creature there is a special protocol. Then they are coming into existence, and we are saying, a`oodhu billahi
min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. Don’t make Allah a bodyguard for you to protect you from Shaytan,
astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah! Do you think that a majestic king is coming to protect you in a place, is that a
protocol? But on His behalf the sultan may be coming for protection.
Therefore, there is something they are asking to make clear, that Allah Almighty has just created Man, and
He created Man through the wombs of women. When Allah Almighty is saying:
•••• ••••••• ••••••••••••• ••• ••••••••••• •••••• ••••••

huwa 'Lladhee yusawwirukum fi 'l-arhaam kayfa yashaa, He it is Who shapes you in the wombs as He pleases.
(3:6)
Allah Almighty, He is that One Who is creating and giving a form for new creation through their mum’s
womb, and really Allah Almighty is not involving, but His angels are coming on behalf of Him, doing this.
O People! When you are asking to do something, do it for your Lord. Everything that you are asking to bring,
to destroy, to do, you must know that you can do that on behalf of your Lord. If not saying that, you are doing
it on behalf of Shaytan. Try to do everything on behalf of your Lord. That is the highest tashreefat, for tazeem,
for making the highest respect and glorifying for Allah. On behalf of His Name, angels and authorized people,
you may reach to them and they are doing everything on behalf of the heavens. People must understand, that
is important. You must do everything on behalf of your Lord. Don’t do anything this without this protocol.
You have been ordered to do everything on behalf of your Lord. It is taking you like a rocket to approach the
Divinely Presence. If you are doing on behalf of your ego, that is on behalf of Shaytan. Now people are doing
on behalf of Shaytan. They have been doing everything, breathing, living, and they forgot to do it on behalf of
their Lord. That is the shaytanic protocol, to do everything on behalf of Shaytan. To do everything for the
Lord, that is protocol. To do everything on behalf of His Name, that is an important protocol. People are
forgetting to do that protocol on behalf of His Name.
Astaghfirullah, forgive us, O our Lord! Bless Your weak servants. You are the only One Who can change
anything 100%. Those that are keeping heavenly protocol will reach to that level in the Divine Presence, but
those who are running after shaytanic protocol, they will fall down into a black hole, never getting up, forever.
Astaghfirullah, we are asking for the honor of that most blessed one, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits.)
(45 minutes)
Dome Dome, Dome Dome 8x
There is heavenly singing. When Sayyidina Jibra’eel (a), Sayyidina Israfeel (a), Sayyidina Mika`eel (a), and
Sayyidina Azra`eel (a), hamalatu ‘l-`Arsh, those who are carrying the Holy Throne, are bringing on mui’kf,

Day of Resurrection. They are singing so beautifully, so beautifully, glorifying Allah Almighty. They are
singing through the plain of people whom will be asked. When they are hearing such beautiful singing, they
are going like this, like that, like this, like that. What happens after it, we can’t say. Therefore, we are
imitating it, saying:
Dome Dome, Dome Dome 8x
Fatihah. O Rabbee!
Thank you for your interest in listening, and Allah (swt) gives you much more honor and much more
roohaniyyaat (fayd, spiritual energy) and nooraniyyaat (spiritual light) to make you much closer to the
Presence of our Lord.
(Mawlana hums the tune, Dome Dome, Dome Dome. )
